Hindi.reason: refers to the Hindi language in the Hindi‑English translation pair mentioned; the paper only mentions it, not studying Hindi resources

Latin.reason: refers to Latin script (cross‑script translation) rather than the Latin language; thus a false positive

Portuguese.reason: refers to the Portuguese language in translation direction English→Portuguese; only mentioned

Chinese.reason: refers to the Chinese language in Chinese‑to‑English translation pairs; only mentioned

Arabic.reason: refers to the Arabic language in Arabic‑English translation pairs; only mentioned

Spanish.reason: refers to the Spanish language in multiple translation pairs; only mentioned

English.reason: refers to the English language both as source/target in translation pairs and as the primary language of the social‑media data analyzed; the paper collects and analyses English data, so it is studied

French.reason: refers to the French language in translation pairs; only mentioned

German.reason: refers to the German language in translation pairs; only mentioned

Japanese.reason: refers to the Japanese language in Japanese‑English translation pairs; only mentioned
